message.content: The kernel uses a degree-5 Taylor-style polynomial for 2^f with f in [-0.5, 0.5]; the truncation error at |f|=0.5 is likely ~2e-6 relative, exceeding the 1e-6 contract tolerance. I'll record targeted claims.

A failure there directly violates the stated tolerance.", "statement": "The degree-5 polynomial approximating 2^fraction produces relative error exceeding 1e-6 for legal BF16 inputs whose reduced fraction is near ±0.5 (inputs near half-integers k+0.5 for k in [-10,9]), violating the per-element relative tolerance contract."}
